name: PaperPlanes Stratified Reconstruction
description: Reconstruct a stratified 3D scene from layered imagery through visual QC.
author: hereliesaz

definitions.name: PaperPlanes Stratified Reconstruction
definitions.description: Reconstruct a stratified 3D scene from layered imagery through visual QC.

agents.name: PaperPlanes Scene Director
agents.description: Define the scene's layer stack and camera path for the stratified reconstruction.

agents.name: PaperPlanes Geometry Engineer
agents.description: Reconstruct each layer's geometry from the source imagery per the scene direction.

agents.name: PaperPlanes Occlusion Architect
agents.description: Resolve occlusion ordering between layers so nearer geometry correctly hides farther geometry.

agents.name: PaperPlanes Layer Engineer
agents.description: Composite the resolved layers into the final stratified scene.

agents.name: PaperPlanes Visual QC
agents.description: Inspect the composited scene for occlusion artifacts, seams, and layer misalignment.
